name: PostgreSQL
description: Advanced open-source relational database server with strong SQL standards support.
longDescription: PostgreSQL is a powerful relational database server. DevForge installs the official EDB build through WinGet as a Windows service. Database credentials are not created or stored by DevForge: you must secure the postgres account immediately after installation and configure your own application roles.
caveats: This is a database server. Installation and service configuration require administrator permission.
DevForge does not create, store or log database passwords. Secure the postgres superuser account immediately after installation.
If the EDB unattended installer requires a superuser password, the installation may fail without it. Check the transaction log for details; DevForge will never invent credentials.
Uninstalling does not delete your database data directory. Back up your databases before removing the server.
The service is configured by the vendor installer. DevForge verifies that the service exists and is running.
